title: Bulk File Downloader to ZIP input
description: Choose public file URLs and download limits. Repeated URLs share one download and one ZIP entry.

urls.title: File URLs
urls.description: Between 1 and 1000 public HTTP or HTTPS file URLs. Private destinations are rejected. The runtime also accepts objects containing a url string.

zipFileName.title: ZIP filename
zipFileName.description: Archive filename and key in the default key-value store. Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores and end with .zip.

prefixIndex.title: Prefix filenames with an index
prefixIndex.description: Add a padded sequential index before each archived filename.

maxFileMegabytes.title: Maximum file size in megabytes
maxFileMegabytes.description: Maximum size of each downloaded file, using 1000000 bytes per megabyte. Oversized files produce report errors.

concurrency.title: Concurrent downloads
concurrency.description: Maximum number of downloads started together. Lower this value when downloading large files.
